integrity: The proof is symbolic in the Neron--Severi lattice and uses the standard K3 base-point criterion. Exact lattice identities are replayable in `verify.py`; no finite computation is used as a substitute for the infinite nefness argument.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the generic \(t=4\) Picard-rank-17 Kummer surface and the specific four-curve replacement of Roulleau--Sarti. It does not classify all automorphisms or all Nikulin configurations, nor other odd-\(\beta_0\) cases.
title: The \(t=4\) replacement Nikulin configuration has the same Kummer structure
